name: Moab
overview: Scripture identifies Moab as the son of Lot, the progenitor of the Moabites (Genesis 19:37). The plains of Moab serve as a significant location where Moses and Eleazar the priest interacted with the Israelites, including numbering the people and rehearsing the law (Numbers 26:3, 26:63; Deuteronomy 29:1). This region also marks the setting where the Israelites renewed their covenant with the LORD and where the land of promise was allotted, highlighting God's continued guidance and provision for His people (Deuteronomy 2:17-18; 29:1).
